description: This file defines the LogicContext interface for the openmrs-core project, specifying methods for patient data evaluation, data source access, and context configuration within the OpenMRS logic module.

classes.name: LogicContext
classes.description: Interface providing methods for evaluating clinical logic rules, accessing patient data, and managing logic context parameters.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the Patient object for the specified patient ID.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Overloaded methods to evaluate logic rules for a patient, with optional parameters and criteria.

methods.name: getLogicDataSource
methods.description: Fetches a data source by name.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a logic data source, with different variants accepting keys or criteria.

methods.name: setIndexDate
methods.description: Sets the index date (effective 'today') for the logic context.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date treated as 'today' within this logic context.

methods.name: setGlobalParameter
methods.description: Sets a global parameter value in the logic context.

methods.name: getGlobalParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a global parameter value by name.

methods.name: getGlobalParameters
methods.description: Returns all global parameters defined in the logic context.
